product_one_liner.value: HAAS Alert’s Safety Cloud helps emergency services and roadway fleets prevent collisions by sending real-time warnings about approaching emergency vehicles and road hazards to drivers through connected vehicles and navigation apps.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes real-time collision-prevention alerts, while the About page explains delivery through navigation apps and passenger vehicles for emergency and roadway fleets: https://www.haasalert.com/ and https://www.haasalert.com/about.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page presents purchasing categories and equipment pricing: https://www.haasalert.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Company case studies identify WJ Group as a Safety Cloud adopter and Cobb County Sheriff's Office as a customer deployment: https://www.haasalert.com/case-study/wj-group-safety-cloud and https://www.haasalert.com/case-study/cobb-county-sheriffs-office. | named_customers.0: The case study explicitly states that WJ Group adopted Safety Cloud: https://www.haasalert.com/case-study/wj-group-safety-cloud. | named_customers.1: HAAS Alert publishes a customer case study naming Cobb County Sheriff's Office: https://www.haasalert.com/case-study/cobb-county-sheriffs-office.

employee_band.notes: Built In reports 70 total employees, which maps to 51-100. This is a third-party headcount rather than a company-confirmed census: https://www.builtinchicago.org/company/haas-alert.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The exhibitor profile explicitly labels the Chicago address as HAAS Alert Global Headquarters: https://www.emergencyuk.com/exhibitors/haas-alert. | hq_country: The company's exhibitor profile labels its Chicago, Illinois address as its Global Headquarters and names the United States: https://www.emergencyuk.com/exhibitors/haas-alert.

founded_year.notes: The investor announcement explicitly states that HAAS Alert was founded in 2015: https://www.volitioncapital.com/news/haas-alert-announcement. The company's history also places its creation of Safety Cloud in 2015: https://www.haasalert.com/about. These primary sources are preferred over the conflicting 2016 date in its LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: The readable media index contains product updates and safety/product marketing articles, including the Spring 2026 product update and a police-technology article. Review did not identify the required two engineer-authored posts explaining internal product construction: https://haasalert.com/media.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base lists multiple product documentation articles, including digital-alert explanations, effectiveness compared with lights and sirens, and transponder installation instructions: https://haas.knowledgeowl.com/help/digital-alerting.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title: https://www.haasalert.com/careers.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or model provider used by Safety Cloud was identified after reviewing documentation, the blog index, security information, and privacy disclosures. The privacy policy provides recipient categories rather than a named AI-subprocessor list. Neutron Edge and Nexar are described as integration partners, not disclosed underlying model providers. Sources reviewed include https://www.haasalert.com/privacy, https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center, https://haas.knowledgeowl.com/help/digital-alerting, https://haasalert.com/media and https://haasalert.com/news/haas-alert-neutron-edge-ai-powered-emergency-response. Null means not publicly established by the reviewed evidence.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center explicitly claims ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR, alongside ISO 9001, which is outside the requested list. These are reported as public claims, not independent verification: https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly named in the company's certification claims: https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001 is explicitly named in the company's certification claims: https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR is explicitly included in the company's public claims; this reports its wording, not an independent determination that GDPR is a certification: https://www.haasalert.com/trust-center.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest announced funding identified is explicitly called a Scale Grant from the Detroit Startup Fund, so the stage is Grant. It is non-dilutive funding, distinct from the earlier Volition equity investment: https://haasalert.com/blog/haas-alert-secures-50-000-scale-grant. | funding_date: The announcement of the received Scale Grant is dated April 17, 2026, yielding 2026-04. This is the announcement month; a separate disbursement date is not established: https://haasalert.com/blog/haas-alert-secures-50-000-scale-grant. | funding_amount_usd: The latest publicly announced financing found is a $50,000 Detroit Startup Fund Scale Grant. This treats non-dilutive grants as funding, rather than reporting only equity rounds: https://haasalert.com/blog/haas-alert-secures-50-000-scale-grant. The earlier January 2024 Volition growth investment did not disclose its amount.

raised_18mo.notes: HAAS Alert announced receipt of a $50,000 Scale Grant on April 17, 2026, inside the 18-month window. True includes non-dilutive grant funding and does not imply a recent equity raise: https://haasalert.com/blog/haas-alert-secures-50-000-scale-grant.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable careers page lists three openings, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive: https://www.haasalert.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 product update announces an available Safety Cloud mobile app and expanded Mutual Aid Sharing. These are substantive launches within six months of November 9, 2026, rather than bug fixes or cosmetic changes: https://www.haasalert.com/blog/safety-cloud-product-update-summer-2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: An external C-level/VP join or departure within the window could not be established conclusively. Brock Aun's profile shows an internal move from VP of Product to Chief Strategy Officer in July 2026, not a new company hire. Available leadership listings and profiles do not conclusively establish an exhaustive absence of external changes, so this is left unknown rather than asserted false. Sources: https://theorg.com/org/haas-alert and https://linkedin.com/in/brockaun.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer posting explicitly calls HubSpot, RevOps.io, Gong and RevHero its existing stack, establishing actual use rather than merely an available integration: https://www.haasalert.com/roles/revops-manager-gtm-engineer. | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot is named as part of the existing revenue-operations stack: https://www.haasalert.com/roles/revops-manager-gtm-engineer. | crm_stack_signal.1: RevOps.io is named as part of the existing revenue-operations stack: https://www.haasalert.com/roles/revops-manager-gtm-engineer. | crm_stack_signal.2: Gong is named as part of the existing revenue-operations stack: https://www.haasalert.com/roles/revops-manager-gtm-engineer. | crm_stack_signal.3: RevHero is named as part of the existing revenue-operations stack: https://www.haasalert.com/roles/revops-manager-gtm-engineer.
